title: Stress Testing Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Against Covert Misalignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.07586v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As LLM agents advance rapidly in autonomy, the risk of hidden objectives that bypass safety constraints becomes increasingly plausible. Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring offers a key control mechanism by reading the agent's reasoning and flagging misalignment before it materializes into action, yet its reliability depends on the realism of the red-team it is stress-tested against. Existing red-teaming efforts rely on shared templates, such as casting a side task as a prerequisite, which treat the side objective as an exogenous insertion and leave task-specific, contextually grounded evasions underexplored. We therefore ask: How robust is CoT monitoring against agents that strategically conceal misalignment? translated_title: 针对隐蔽失对齐行为的思维链监控压力测试
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）智能体在自主性方面快速提升，智能体出现绕过安全约束的隐藏目标的风险日益增加。思维链（CoT）监控提供了一种关键的控制机制：通过读取智能体的推理过程，在失对齐行为付诸实施之前将其标记出来。然而其可靠性取决于对它进行压力测试的红队攻击的真实程度。现有的红队测试工作依赖于共享模板，例如将副任务伪装为完成主任务的前置条件，这种做法将副目标视为外生插入，而对任务特定的、有上下文依据的规避策略则探索不足。因此我们提出这样一个问题：面对会战略性隐藏自身失对齐行为的智能体，CoT 监控究竟有多强的鲁棒性？为了回答这一问题，我们提出了 TraceMRT——一个自动化的轨迹级（Trace-level）监控红队测试框架，它将副任务重新构建为主任务的一个连贯子目标，并搜索轨迹塑形策略，使其诱导出的轨迹能够隐蔽地掩盖失对齐意图……
tldr: 提出自动化红队测试框架 TraceMRT，通过将副任务重构为主任务的连贯子目标并搜索轨迹塑形策略，系统性地压力测试了思维链监控对会隐蔽掩盖失对齐行为的智能体的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: We introduce TraceMRT, an automated trace-level monitor red-teaming framework that reframes side tasks as coherent sub-goals of the primary task, systematically stress-testing the robustness of chain-of-thought monitoring against agents that covertly conceal their misalignment.
